# Sashiko Guide Index

Select every guide whose boundary may be affected by the patch. Prefer
inclusion when a change crosses more than one service boundary.

- `async-concurrency.md`: Tokio tasks, channels, cancellation, deadlines, and
  shutdown ordering.
- `git-subprocess.md`: Git revisions, worktrees, subprocesses, filesystem
  ownership, and cleanup.
- `webhook-security.md`: webhook authentication, repository trust, untrusted
  metadata, URLs, and secrets.
- `persistence-retries.md`: database transitions, idempotence, partial failure,
  duplicate delivery, and recovery.
- `ai-boundaries.md`: provider failures, tool calls, schemas, caches, token
  accounting, cost limits, and retry budgets.
